ferrari.name: Ferrari
ferrari.tagline: From coachbuilt V12s to the hybrid age.
ferrari.intro: A chronological road-car catalog, from the early Inter touring cars to today’s production families. Follow each model’s body styles and major design changes.

films.title: Ferrari
films.description: A dramatisation of Enzo Ferrari’s personal and business crisis around the 1957 Mille Miglia. Treat it as a drama rather than a literal historical record.

films.title: Ferrari: Race to Immortality
films.description: The lives, rivalries and losses of Ferrari drivers during the dangerous 1950s racing era.

films.title: Ford v Ferrari / Le Mans ’66
films.description: The Ford-Ferrari Le Mans rivalry, told mainly from the Shelby and Miles side. Ferrari is central to the rivalry rather than the sole subject.

films.title: Schumacher
films.description: A driver biography with substantial Ferrari-era material. It is not a full history of Ferrari’s road cars.

films.title: Megafactories / Ultimate Factories: Ferrari FF
films.description: A production-focused episode about the FF, useful for seeing the factory and assembly process. Episode naming and ordering differ by territory.

films.title: Formula 1: Drive to Survive
films.description: A wider Formula One series, not a single-brand history. Ferrari and Mercedes feature from season two onward.

lamborghini.name: Lamborghini
lamborghini.tagline: Grand tourers, wedges and new extremes.
lamborghini.intro: From the first front-engined GT to mid-engined sports cars, SUVs and road-going few-offs. Open a model to trace its changing shape.

films.title: Lamborghini: The Man Behind the Legend
films.description: A dramatisation of Ferruccio Lamborghini’s life and the creation of the company. Its characters and events should not be treated as documentary evidence.

films.title: Megafactories / Ultimate Factories: Lamborghini
films.description: Factory episodes cover the Murciélago SV and Aventador production programmes. The official series guide identifies the cars; regional episode numbers vary.

porsche.name: Porsche
porsche.intro: Rear engines, transaxles, mid-engined sports cars and electric platforms. Read the road-car families chronologically, then compare their generations.

films.title: Endurance
films.description: Follows the Porsche GT Team through the 2019 Le Mans and Nürburgring 24-hour races, held on consecutive weekends.

films.title: Le Mans
films.description: A racing drama famous for its Porsche 917 and 911 imagery, mixing staged sequences with footage from the 1970 race.

films.title: Porsche: Decades of Disruption
films.description: A brand-produced retrospective following Porsche’s road-car development from the 356 toward its modern range.

films.title: Megafactories / Ultimate Factories: Porsche 911
films.description: A production-focused look at the 911 and its assembly. Use the car title rather than a regional season/episode number.

tesla.name: Tesla
tesla.tagline: The electric car, in changing forms.
tesla.intro: From the original Roadster to saloons, crossovers, the personal-use Cybertruck and the Cybercab production programme. Models and major redesigns share one visual timeline.

films.title: Revenge of the Electric Car
films.description: Follows Tesla, Nissan, GM and an independent converter during the return of the electric car. Tesla is one of several central stories.

films.title: The New York Times Presents: Elon Musk’s Crash Course
films.origin: Emma Schwartz / The New York Times / FX
films.description: Season 2, episode 1 investigates Tesla’s Autopilot programme and the gap between promises and real-world operation.

films.title: Megafactories / Ultimate Factories: Tesla Model S
films.description: A production-focused episode about the Model S. This is about Tesla the car company, not the unrelated films about inventor Nikola Tesla.

mercedes.name: Mercedes-Benz
mercedes.intro: The Mercedes-Benz road-car families from the 1926 merger onward, including carry-over models, pre-war touring cars, modern class lineages and AMG road cars.

films.title: Magical Moments: The Hour of the Silver Arrows
films.description: A motorsport history combining archive footage, period cars and reenactments. The manufacturer’s role and the reconstructed scenes are part of its presentation.

films.title: Carl & Bertha
films.description: A dramatisation of Carl and Bertha Benz’s lives and the early automobile. It covers a predecessor company, before the Mercedes-Benz merger.

films.title: Formula 1: Drive to Survive
films.description: A wider Formula One series, not a single-brand history. Ferrari and Mercedes feature from season two onward.
